ruleTypeDescription.acceptedValues: Checks that a column's values all come from an accepted list.
ruleTypeDescription.aggregate: Aggregates a column (sum, average, extremes and so on) and checks the value against a range. PERCENTILE is available on PostgreSQL and SQL Server only.
ruleTypeDescription.celExpression: Evaluates a CEL expression over a sample of rows.
ruleTypeDescription.crossColumn: Checks that two columns in the same row satisfy a comparison.
ruleTypeDescription.crossTable: Reconciles one aggregate of this table with one of another table, for example their row-count difference.
ruleTypeDescription.customSql: Runs custom SQL and judges the number of rows it returns.
ruleTypeDescription.freshness: Checks that the newest timestamp in a column is recent enough.
ruleTypeDescription.groupCheck: Groups rows by columns and checks each group's row count against the bounds.
ruleTypeDescription.nullPercent: Checks that a column's NULL count or NULL share stays under the bound.
ruleTypeDescription.range: Checks that a numeric or date column stays inside the expected range.
ruleTypeDescription.referentialIntegrity: Checks that every child value exists in the parent table.
ruleTypeDescription.regex: Checks that a text column matches a regular expression. Not available on SQL Server.
ruleTypeDescription.rowCount: Checks that the filtered row count falls inside the expected range.
ruleTypeDescription.rowCountChange: Checks whether the row count changed more than the allowed percentage since the previous run.
ruleTypeDescription.schemaDrift: Compares the live column list with the snapshot saved when the check was created.
ruleTypeDescription.stringLength: Checks that a text column's length stays between the bounds.
ruleTypeDescription.unique: Checks that a column's values are unique; NULLs are ignored by default.
ruleTypeDescription.uniqueCombination: Checks that a combination of columns is unique; NULLs are ignored by default.

identityProviderSettings.bindingsDescription: Which account signs in through which provider subject. Removing a link revokes that way in; the account keeps every other one.
identityProviderSettings.bindingsEmpty: No account is linked to an identity provider
identityProviderSettings.bindingsLoadFailed: Failed to load the linked accounts
identityProviderSettings.createFailed: Failed to create the identity provider
identityProviderSettings.deleteFailed: Failed to delete the identity provider
identityProviderSettings.deleteMessage: Accounts linked to this provider keep their link but can no longer sign in through it. Re-creating the provider with the same ID restores them.
identityProviderSettings.description: Configure the OAuth2 providers members sign in with. Each provider is one way in; an account can be bound to several.
identityProviderSettings.emptyDescription: Members sign in with a password until one is added.
identityProviderSettings.fieldAuthStyleInHeader: Send client ID and secret as HTTP Basic authorization
identityProviderSettings.fieldAuthStyleInParams: Send client ID and secret in the request body
identityProviderSettings.fieldClientSecretKept: Leave empty to keep the stored secret
identityProviderSettings.fieldDomainHint: Used when the provider reports an identifier that is not an address: the sign-in then builds the address from the identifier and this domain.
identityProviderSettings.fieldGroupsHint: When set, every sign-in syncs the account's group membership to the workspace groups with a matching ID, which is how an IAM policy grants roles by group.
identityProviderSettings.fieldIdHint: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. Immutable: accounts are bound to it, so re-creating the same ID is what makes them reachable again.
identityProviderSettings.fieldIdentifierHint: Names the account. It is mutable, so it never identifies one by itself.
identityProviderSettings.fieldMappingDescription: Which claim of the user info response carries each field. A claim path may be dotted, e.g. realm_access.roles.
identityProviderSettings.fieldSkipTlsVerifyWarning: Warning: with this on, anyone who can intercept the connection can forge the user info response and take over every account bound to this provider.
identityProviderSettings.fieldSubjectHint: Required in effect: an account is bound to this value. Leave empty only for a provider listed under the workspace's email identity providers, which accepts its address claim instead.
identityProviderSettings.invalidId: The ID must start with a lower-case letter and contain only lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.
identityProviderSettings.invalidIdentifier: Enter the claim that carries the address.
identityProviderSettings.loadFailed: Failed to load the identity providers
identityProviderSettings.noPermission: You do not have permission to view the identity providers.
identityProviderSettings.saveFailed: Failed to save the identity provider
identityProviderSettings.testUnavailable: This provider cannot start a test. Check its authorization URL.
identityProviderSettings.title: Identity providers
identityProviderSettings.unbindMessage: This account will no longer sign in through this provider identity. If it has no password and no other link, an administrator has to reset it.
